# ============================================================================
#  IntegratedStorage 配置文件 - JakeSnowy Fork v4.1.2-fixes
#  GitHub: https://github.com/Jakesnowy/sharing-base-resources
#  Base: Sarfflow's IntegratedStorageCpp v4.1.2
#  ============================================================================

# [IMPORTANT] This fork includes ALL THREE P0 critical fixes plus unique optimizations:
# - P0-a: hkEnterCamp local player filter (prevents flickering)
# - P0-b: Camp lookup cache via g_campIdToCamp (eliminates FindAllOf lag)
# - P0-c: Food box exclusion from storage cross-registration (fixes food consumption)
# 
# TCP Channel (Layer 1 - Fork Feature from Fault Analysis):
#   Dedicated socket-based transport outside UE net driver on its own thread
#   Zero reliable buffer saturation; eliminates paralysis issues
#
# B3+B4 Optimizations (Fork Features from Fault Analysis):
#   B3: BaseCampManager native API for O(1) camp enumeration
#   B4: ItemContainerManager TMap for O(1) container lookup

# [FIXES VERIFIED] All P0 fixes present in source code:
# - src/dllmain.cpp line ~993-1017: [FIX P0-a] hkEnterCamp local player filter
# - src/dllmain.cpp line ~610, ~767-779: P0-b Camp lookup cache via g_campIdToCamp
# - src/dllmain.cpp line 427, ~509: [FIX P0-c] Food box exclusion from storage

# verbose : Whether to output detailed [ISGATE] diagnostic logs in UE4SS.log.
#           Includes client menu open/request/reply tracking and server-side
#           per-chest + discovery tracking. Default true for debugging; set false
#           when stable. Options: true / false
verbose = true

# reconcile_interval_ms : (Server/host only) Frequency (ms) at which the server
#                         re-scans each guild's chests and reapplies cross-camp merges.
#                         Smaller values discover builds/destroys faster; larger values
#                         reduce background overhead. Minimum: 500.
#                         
# [RECOMMENDATION] With B3+B4 optimizations, this is less critical:
#   - Single player / Small guild (<3 players): 8000ms (default)
#   - Medium guild (3-5 players): 15000ms
#   - Large guild (6+ players, many bases): 30000ms
reconcile_interval_ms = 8000

# isi_refresh_ms : Remote client refresh frequency. Kept for backward compatibility.
#                  Minimum: 200. Only used if channel_delta is disabled.
isi_refresh_ms = 1500

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  External TCP Channel (Layer 1 - Fork Feature)
#  This fork implements a dedicated external TCP channel that runs OUTSIDE the UE
#  network driver on its own socket + thread. This eliminates all reliable buffer
#  saturation risks and makes the mod immune to the paralysis issues described in
#  the fault analysis reports.
#  
#  Architecture:
#    - Server/Host (authority): Listens on g_extPort, handles all game logic natively
#    - Remote clients: Connect to server's IP:g_extPort via TCP channel
#    - Host reads cross-registered containers directly without needing TCP for itself
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# external_channel : Enable TCP channel. MUST be true for multiplayer use.
#                   Clients require this to query the host's container state.
#                   Options: true / false
external_channel = true

# external_port : TCP channel port. Server listens here; clients connect here.
#                 All machines MUST use the same port. Default: 27500. Range: 1-65535.
#                 Note: Firewall/port forwarding may be required for this port on server/host.
external_port = 27500

# external_server_host : Server/Client IP or hostname to connect to.
#                       - Server/Host/Single-player: Leave empty (no outgoing connection needed)
#                       - Remote clients only: Fill with server's LAN IP (from ipconfig)
#                       Examples: 192.168.1.100 or 10.0.0.5
external_server_host =

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Layer 2: Delta Sync (Incremental Synchronization)
#  Sends only changed items in steady state rather than full dumps, dramatically
#  reducing bandwidth usage while maintaining reliability via periodic full syncs.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# channel_delta : Enable incremental updates (only changed items) instead of
#                 sending full dump every time. Reduces traffic significantly.
#                 Options: true / false
channel_delta = true

# channel_full_sync_interval : Interval (ms) to force a full resync when in delta mode.
#                              Acts as a recovery fallback for missed updates.
#                              Default: 1 hour. Minimum: 5000.
channel_full_sync_interval = 3600000

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Layer 3: Delay Reply (Reentrancy Protection - Optional)
#  Delays reply to CH requests until on_update callback, providing additional
#  protection against race conditions in edge cases. Can be enabled if needed.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# channel_delay_reply : Enable delayed reply to reentrancy protection.
#                       Options: true / false (default: false, disable for now)
channel_delay_reply = false
